body: The open source codebase powering HuggingChat
plain_description: **Give your team a browser based chat interface for large language models.** Connect it to an OpenAI compatible provider and let users chat with models. Add optional model routing and MCP tools.
technical_description: Chat UI is a SvelteKit application that powers HuggingChat. It connects to OpenAI-compatible APIs, discovers models through the `/models` endpoint, and stores chat history, users, settings, files, and stats in MongoDB (or embedded MongoDB for local development). It supports Docker deployment, optional model routing, MCP server tools, and experimental ML Intern workflows.
title: Chat UI
